newsitem.title: CONGO: Congolese rivals exchange fire near airport.
newsitem.headline: Congolese rivals exchange fire near airport.

text.p: Supporters of President Pascal Lissouba and the Congo Republic's former military leader Denis Sassou Nguesso exchanged fire in the capital on Tuesday one day after mediation efforts collapsed, witnesses said.

Small arms fire rattled round the international airport during the night and exchanges continued there through the morning. France continued to pull its troops out of Brazzaville after evacuating more than 5,000 foreign nationals.

Fighting broke out in the city on June 5 after government troops surrounded the home of Sassou Nguesso as part of a crackdown on private militia and illegal possession of weapons in the runup to a July 27 presidential election.
